name: Nordkette: Hafelekar and the Goetheweg
why: From the cable car above Innsbruck along a rocky high path with the city 1,700 m below on one side and the wild Karwendel on the other.
book: Nordkettenbahnen cable car from the city centre (paid).
water: Pfeishütte at the end; carry 1 litre.
dangers: Afternoon thunderstorms in summer: start early and be off ridges by 14:00.

points.name: Hafelekar
points.note: The top station at 2,256 m above Innsbruck.

points.name: Pfeishütte
points.note: A mountain hut in a high valley of the Karwendel.
